feeds.title: Opera Gene
feeds.description: Opera Gene's goal is to provide commentary, criticism, and information to assist the opera fan in accessing and enjoying opera, those who share the opera gene.

feeds.title: DC Theater Arts
feeds.description: DC Theater Arts has played a key role in the Washington, DC area performing arts community. Through reviews, feature articles and interviews, news stories, and opinion pieces, we provide our readers with comprehensive coverage of the local and regional performing arts scene.

feeds.title: Parterre Box
feeds.description: Where opera is king and you, the readers, are queens.

feeds.title: Seen and Heard International
feeds.description: Established in 1999 Seen and Heard International has internationally based correspondents reporting on a wide range of music and other events Seen and Heard.

feeds.title: Utah Opera
feeds.description: The founders of the Utah Symphony and Utah Opera believed that the people of our state would be inspired by the music of the highest caliber and set forth to create organizations that would enrich the lives of every citizen with music. In 2002, the Utah Symphony and Utah Opera came together to create greater impact and joined forces under the same vision. This vision is to connect the community through great live music. To perform. To engage. To inspire.

feeds.title: Opera Colorado Blog
feeds.description: Opera Colorado has brought world-class opera to Denver and beyond since its founding in 1981. Opera Colorado presents opera performances that inspire the audience & serves the community through education and cultural programs.

feeds.title: The Opera Tattler
feeds.description: The Opera Tattler authored by Charlise Tiee is a blog on reviews of performances and their audiences, with an emphasis on San Francisco Opera.

feeds.title: OperaJournal
feeds.description: OperaJournal is a blog by Keris Nine on opera perfomences, music, and theatre.

feeds.title: Vienna's Opera Blog
feeds.description: Vienna's opera blog aims to stimulate enjoyment of opera, demystifying an often rarefied and snobbish medium, to make opera accessible to a wider audience and to provoke debate.

feeds.title: Operaramblings Blog
feeds.description: This is a blog focused on classical vocal music, opera, art song and choral.

feeds.title: Edmonton Opera Blog
feeds.description: Edmonton Opera is dedicated to producing great performances that bring the powerful emotions of opera to our community.

feeds.title: Glasgow Theatre Blog
feeds.description: The aim of the blog is to publicise and review arts events in Glasgow and the Greater Glasgow area. The best place for news, interviews and reviews of theatre in Glasgow, Scotland and beyond.

feeds.title: Opera Ville
feeds.description: Operaville is a blog by Michael J. Vaughn on opera, classiacl music, theatre. Michael J. Vaughn is the author of seventeen novels, including The Popcorn Girl and Billy Saddle.

feeds.title: MidWalesOpera Blog
feeds.description: Mid Wales Opera crafts and performs fully-staged and intimate touring opera productions at venues across Wales & beyond. We are passionate about opera, taking inspiring productions into theatres and spaces where live opera is rarely seen and bringing it to new audiences. We are committed to nurturing, challenging and encouraging young and fresh talent.

feeds.title: The Opera Queen
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Catherine Kustanczy. I am a freelance arts writer with a focus on classical music, opera, theatre, and cultural history and thought. I am a Professor of Media and Communications, with a speciality in creative audio storytelling, in both verbal and aural formats. I'm as much interested in pedagogy, musicological questions, theatrical experimentation, and more.

feeds.title: B'Opera Blog
feeds.description: Believing that children need to participate freely in cultural life and the arts, B'Opera create high-quality, interactive, musical experiences for babies, toddlers and their grown-ups of all backgrounds. B'Opera is founded on the desire to bring people together around a shared experience of beauty, illuminating what we have in common.

feeds.title: Opera Post
feeds.description: Opera Post is your place to review the present and rehearse the past with Charles Affron & Mirella Jona Affron, co-authors of Grand Opera: The Story of the Met.

feeds.title: Amherst Opera House Blog
feeds.description: The Amherst Opera House Co. Guild is a 501(c)3 non-profit that was formed to return the Amherst Opera House to community use. We envision the historic Amherst Opera House as a venue for local theatre, visual arts, community gatherings, and music. We seek to collaborate with many different existing programs including art galleries, seasonal concerts, and educational lectures.

feeds.title: Opera on Video Blog
feeds.description: Opera on Video gives the opera lover and opera fan a complete archive of all full operas recorded on video as well as concerts, documentaries, interviews and movies related to opera, composers and singers.

feeds.title: Santa Fe Opera Blog
feeds.description: The Santa Fe Opera's mission is to advance the operatic art form by presenting ensemble performances of the highest quality in a unique setting with a varied repertoire of new, rarely performed and standard works. Press Center offers resources for reviewers and others, including press releases, high-resolution image galleries, and more.

feeds.title: The Grand Opera House Blog
feeds.description: At The Grand Opera House, it is our mission to nurture an appreciation of the Arts in all citizens of Central Georgia, especially its youngest citizens, through attracting the presentation of quality productions as well as an immersion into a treasured architectural artefact that reflects 116 years of Macon's history.

feeds.title: Boulder Opera Company Blog
feeds.description: The Boulder Opera is committed to making opera accessible, inspiring and engaging to the community. Our goal is to develop new audiences for this old art form, enrich the lives of our community, and provide opportunities to local musicians. Since 2012, we have brought high-quality opera to the Boulder audience.

feeds.title: Planet Hugill
feeds.description: Planet Hugill is a London-based classical music blog written by composer, journalist and singer Robert Hugill. Get Classical music news, opera, concert & CD reviews, live performance previews, features and musings on contemporary music from classical music composer, Robert Hugill.

feeds.title: Fort Worth Opera Blog
feeds.description: Fort Worth Opera is committed to producing opera of the highest possible artistic quality and integrity; to identifying and training talented young American singers. The mission of Fort Worth Opera is to enrich people's lives with performances and programs that educate, entertain, inspire, and expand the horizons of current and future audiences.

feeds.title: Seattle Opera
feeds.description: Founded in 1963, Seattle Opera is one of the leading opera companies in the United States. The company is recognized internationally for the quality of its productions, supportive and nurturing environment for singers and artists.

feeds.title: Opera Traveller
feeds.description: Operatraveller.com exists to create truly independent writing on opera. The site aims to present opera criticism that is readable, knowledgeable and that takes nothing for granted. To review the most interesting and stimulating opera, both in Europe and in North America. To present artist interviews that allow the artist to discuss technique as well as approaches to interpretation.

feeds.title: Opera-Online
feeds.description: Opera-Online is the whole universe of lyrical art helping you better understand opera to love it more. You can find news from opera world, detailed info on different acts, updates on events & festivals, and more.

feeds.title: Slippedisc » Opera
feeds.description: The following section of Slippedisc is dedicated to Opera, giving an inside track on classical music and related cultures, by Norman Lebrecht. Slippedisc was founded on another site in 2007 by the author and broadcaster Norman Lebrecht with the aim of providing swift and reliable inside information on classical music and related arts.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Opera
feeds.description: Read the latest news on events, music, art, people, and more from the world of Opera in the following segment of The Guardian. Guardian Media Group is a global news organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism - giving a voice to the powerless and holding power to account.

feeds.title: Wolf Trap Opera Blog
feeds.description: Wolf Trap Opera is dedicated to creating excellent performing arts experiences for the enrichment, education, and enjoyment of diverse audiences.

feeds.title: The Dallas Opera
feeds.description: The Dallas Opera is a perfect introduction to this endlessly entertaining art form.

feeds.title: A Younger Theatre s Blog
feeds.description: A Younger Theatre give opportunities to emerging creatives to engage in theatre and the arts through partnerships and events, digital takeovers and socials.

feeds.title: OperaChaser
feeds.description: OperaChaser ia blog about opera, music, theatre, art and more.

feeds.title: Opera Inside
feeds.description: Covers guide to classical music and opera art with a historical reference, exciting ideas and background information about Opera.

feeds.title: Il giardino di Armida
feeds.description: An attempt to opera reviews.

feeds.title: Opera Teens Blog
feeds.description: Opera Teens is a national initiative to empower high-schoolers to pursue their interests in opera, share opera learning with others and leverage the power of opera to serve local communities.

feeds.title: Meet Me At The Opera
feeds.description: MeetMeAtTheOpera.com is a social media platform and digital destination for opera lovers around the world. We make it possible for opera enthusiasts everywhere to find each other at the Opera Houses, Summer Opera Festivals, HD Opera, enjoy performances, and grow their cultural and intellectual communities. Follow our blog feed for the latest opera news, festivals, and more.

feeds.title: Espionage (Casey Creel)
feeds.description: Sounding board for an opera-going language teacher. I'm a 35 year-old teacher living in Switzerland. I used to sing in a choir here in Zürich, where I live with my husband, who is a Ph.D student. Espionage is a blog about teaching, language, music, writing, reading and ideas; living in a crowded and noisy world; being an expert layperson.

feeds.title: Opera Lovers of Rhode Island
feeds.description: Posts on opera related events happening in Rhode Island.

feeds.title: Operavision
feeds.description: Operavision is a blog on Aprile Millo's view of the opera world.

feeds.title: Superconductor Classical and Opera
feeds.description: Superconductor includes classical music and opera reviews, concert reviews and criticism in and around New York City by Paul Pelkonen.

feeds.title: Opera In Reach
feeds.description: Opera In Reach is your source to read about discussions revolving around the issues on the civic impact on opera. We are an opera outreach collective dedicated to inspiring the next generation to see themselves in opera. We want to connect with minority communities, educational institutions, opera companies, other collectives, in hopes of creating a space free of barriers and limitations due to one identity.

feeds.title: On Site Opera Blog
feeds.description: On Site Opera produces site-specific operas in non-traditional venues throughout New York City and beyond. Since its founding in 2012, On Site Opera has grown into a community of people who are excited to take opera to new places and amplify the connection between the world of opera and reality through music and drama.

feeds.title: Rohs Opera House
feeds.description: The Rohs Opera House is the oldest continuous running theatre in Kentucky. It is our goal to provide affordable entertainment to Cynthiana and the surrounding area. We offer movies, plays, concerts, comedy, variety shows and much, much more.

feeds.title: AVA Opera
feeds.description: Academy of Vocal Arts is devoted to training young artists with tremendous potential as international opera soloists. The mission of the Academy of Vocal Arts is to be the world's premier institution for training young artists as international opera soloists. You can read our Adventures and Musical Insights at the Academy of Vocal Arts.

feeds.title: Amplified Opera
feeds.description: Amplified Opera is here to listen. We want to hold space for challenging and diverse voices to express themselves and share their experiences in a way that feels authentic and on their own terms. We produce shows that invite conversation and challenge the status quo.

feeds.title: Stark Conductor » Opera Knowledge
feeds.description: The follwoing section of Stark Conductor is dedicated to articles on Opera Knowledge. In his interpretations, Jonathan Stark combines historically informed style competence with technical precision. A passionate advocate of contemporary music, he made his debut at the Wien Modern festival in the 2018/19 season. Stark launched the StarkConductor Blog, where he has since been blogging about classical music and engaging with audiences.

feeds.title: Palm Beach Opera Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1961, Palm Beach Opera is dedicated to producing live opera at an international standard of excellence, enriching the lives of the communities it serves with a diverse offering of educational programs, and to training the next generation of opera stars.

feeds.title: Le Corso del Destino
feeds.description: A journey in classical music. Read the blog to find classical music, opera, and related news from Chicago - written by Claire Liu.

feeds.title: Living Opera
feeds.description: Living Opera strives to inform, equip and empower singers, educators, and people who love music about the realities of a professional career in the performing arts. We are passionate about creating a worldwide dialogue that improves the lives of our present, and future colleagues.

feeds.title: Tacoma Opera
feeds.description: We are Tacoma's own professional opera company, proudly serving the south Puget Sound region and the entire Pacific Northwest by offering traditional and non-traditional operatic productions in an intimate, atmospheric setting that allows our audiences to experience opera in a uniquely personal way, touching the heart and stimulating the mind.

feeds.title: San Francisco Opera Blog
feeds.description: We have been thrilling audiences in San Francisco since 1923. We are known for commissioning numerous world premieres, training some of opera's greatest young artists and being one of the world's leading opera companies. Stay up to date with San Francisco's opera news and events. Hear from locals and insiders on the latest events for San Francisco Opera.
